SSL::mode
Description
Gets the enabled/disabled state of SSL
Syntax
SSL
::
mode
SSL::mode
Gets the enabled/disabled state of SSL. Returns 1 if it is enabled,
and 0 if it is disabled.
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
if
{
[
TCP
::
local_port
]
!=
443
}
{
SSL
::
disable
}
}
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
if
{
[
SSL
::
mode
]
==
0
}
{
HTTP
::
redirect
"https://some.other.site.com/"
}
}
